questions: Should anyone be able to add events, or only certain people (for example, church staff with a password)?
Can someone sign up more than once for the same event with the same phone number? Or can one sign-up bring extra people, like family members, who count toward the limit?
Can people cancel their sign-up to free up the spot? And when an event is full, should people be turned away or added to a waiting list?
answers: Refuse the sign-up and say the event is full.
